corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2v2.dominant_class_regression: Same-shape plausible-but-wrong rule applications (59.1% of real errors, 81.4% of wrong-candidate pairs, median Hamming 0.40): v2 scored 0.502 macro / 0.3283 pair-weighted — BELOW chance and REGRESSED from v1 (0.6283/0.4707). Mechanism: the near-miss curriculum (median changed-cell fraction 0.083) teaches 'gold + small defect = bad', ranking coherent wrong rule-applications BELOW gold.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2v2.gate1_blind_spot: Gate-1 (synthetic near-miss AUROC 0.7893) measures curriculum-fitting, not transfer: the v1 model passes the IDENTICAL synthetic gate at 0.7291 (>0.70). The committed 'v1 measured 0.481 here' contrast was a category error (v1's REAL-pool near-miss AUROC vs the synthetic gate). v2's REAL-pool <=5%-cell near-miss AUROC: 0.58-0.60 plain / 0.60-0.69 TTA (vote: 0.95 on the same class). Gate-1 was honest as computed (seed-stable 0.79-0.83; committed value the lowest of four seeds) but does not predict selection.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2v2.generator_independence_violation: Negatives were mined from the SAME TRM checkpoint (arc_v1_public/step_518071) as the eval-pool generator; the panel spec'd a different seed/early checkpoint. The violation is in the direction that should HELP selection — and selection still landed at random, which strengthens the negative.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2v2.mined_axis_was_a_silent_noop: The 'mined REAL TRM errors' curriculum axis never effectively ran. Miner bug (scripts/experiments/arc3_gap3_stage2v2_mine_real_negs.py run_join: inv_fn(_crop(inputs[i])) yields EMPTY grids on translation-augmented rows): 240/250 mined negatives are keyed to the empty-grid hash and are structurally unjoinable by the (task, input-hash) collate key. Effective coverage: 10 usable negatives / 6 slots / 3 tasks / 688 exposures = 0.04% of ~1.74M negative exposures (~24x less than the disclosed 'THIN 250/10/16'). v2 therefore tested the structured-synthetic arm ONLY — which makes the negative cleaner.
corrigendum_2026_06_09_stage2v2.mining_yield_was_a_padding_artifact: mined_meta.n_wrong_rows=18390 (59.9%) is off ~500x: 18,380 of the 18,390 'wrong rows' are padding rows. TRM's genuine error rate on real rows of its own training split is 10/8,259 = 0.12% (it MEMORIZES the split). A fixed full-split miner would yield ~O(500) real negatives, not ~12k — the real-error-dominant curriculum is structurally unsuppliable from this checkpoint's training split.
